Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: planning cost per km, km between services, revenue per working day, days a workshop invoice may stay unpaid, and the tyre, reefer and defect limits.
Check Trucks, Trailers, Drivers and Workshops and Vendors. Add your own workshops, tyre shops and parts suppliers with their phone and hourly rate.
Enter every workshop job on Maintenance Log. Total cost, the asset, the payment check and the phone numbers fill in by themselves.
Keep Service Schedule current: type the last service date and km and the odometer now, and read the km left, the due date and the overdue flag.
Record every unplanned stop on Breakdowns. A row with no back-in-service date shows the truck as in the shop, and the lost revenue is counted at your revenue per day.
Read Repair Cost per Truck and Cost of Ownership to see which truck costs most per km, then test the older ones on Truck Replacement.
Log tyre jobs on Tyre Jobs and update Tyre Wear; use Spare Parts, Warranty Claims, Defect Follow-up, Reefer Unit Hours and Trailer Use for the rest of the fleet.
Type the odometer of every truck on Odometer Readings at the end of each month, and keep Fleet by Month for downtime and the maintenance budget.
Check Truck Financing for payments, balance and the date of the last payment on every loan.

Use the 14 calculators: service due, cost per km, repair or replace, downtime, tyre retread, spare reorder, budget, availability, financing, lease or buy, resale, reefer service, trailers and a what-if grid.
Read Fleet Maintenance Dashboard and Charts every month: maintenance cost, downtime, availability, tyre cost, open defects and the cost per km of each truck.

Weekly driver settlements with pay, deductions and net
One row per driver and week: loaded km, empty km, per diem, waiting pay and bonus; gross pay, net pay, pay per loaded km, driver cost per km and whether it was paid in time fill in by themselves.
Pay rates by driver with every change
One row for each pay rate a driver has had: rate per loaded km, empty km rate, per diem and waiting time share; the earlier rate, the change, the months employed and the cost per loaded km fill in.
Weekly km and loads per driver against the km target
One row per driver and week of the last 14 weeks; the share of the weekly km target, the km per load and whether the driver is above target fill in.
Per diem days away and the amount
One row per driver and week: days away and the per diem rate; the amount and the share of the week away fill in.
Advances and deductions with the balance still owed
One row per advance or deduction taken from a driver: amount, weekly instalment and what was repaid; the balance, the weeks left and the status fill in.
One row per load with waiting time: hours, the charge billed to the customer and the share paid to the driver; the amount, pay per hour and a check for missing arrival and departure times fill in.
Quarterly bonus from safety, fuel use and on-time rate
One row per driver and quarter: safety points, fuel use against the truck norm and on-time rate; the goals met and the bonus earned fill in from the limits on the Start sheet.
Driver scorecard with score and rank each quarter
One row per driver and quarter: litres per 100 km, on-time rate, incidents and inspection result; the score out of 100, the rank in the quarter and the fuel gap to the truck norm fill in.
Driver and truck profit each quarter
One row per driver and quarter: revenue of the truck, fuel, upkeep, truck payments and pay; the truck cost, profit, profit per week and pay per loaded km fill in so the weakest truck shows.
Office payroll for the dispatcher and the bookkeeper
One row per person and month: salary and overtime; gross pay, employer cost, the total cost and whether it was paid fill in.
Owner pay and draws with the year to date
One row per month: the regular draw and any extra draw; the total, the year to date and whether it was paid fill in.
Time off and leave with the cover plan
One row per request: dates, type, cover plan and status; the days, whether the driver is away now and the days to the start fill in.
One row per driver and week of the plan: days at home and loads planned; the days away and a check against the weekly limit on the Start sheet fill in.
Driver hiring pipeline with the days in the pipeline
One row per applicant from the first contact to the offer: role, licence class, interview and offered rate; whether the candidate is still open and the days in the pipeline fill in.
Training and certificates with the days to renewal
One row per course taken or booked: date, valid until and cost; the days to renewal and a valid, due soon or expired status fill in.
Driver turnover and cost to hire by month
One row per month: drivers who left, drivers hired, drivers at the end of the month and the hiring spend; the turnover rate and the cost per hire fill in.
One row per item given to a driver: value and issue date; whether it is still out and the days out fill in so nothing is lost when a driver changes truck or leaves.
One row per dispute: week, issue, amount and the day it was settled; the days open and an overdue flag for disputes open longer than two weeks fill in.
Driving hours planner against the weekly limit
One row per driver and week: driving hours and rest days; the hours left against the weekly limit on the Start sheet, the overtime and a limit check fill in.
